title: MT60149: Surfaces And Interfaces
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Surface free energy, Equilibrium shape - Wulff theorem, Interface-phase
concept, Grain boundary equilibria, Multiphase equilibria, Surface Tension:
concept and quantification, Surface and interfacial free energy. Surface
structure of liquid and solid metals, Interfacial structure â grain boundary,
stacking fault and twins; Adsorption and Absorption; Adhesion and wetting
kinetics, Nucleation and growth at interface, Sintering and fracture mechanism,
Film nucleation and growth mechanism; Film and coating synthesis via
sputtering, vapor deposition, atomic layer epitaxy and thermal spray
techniques; Electrical, optical, mechanical and magnetic properties and
applications. Nanoindentation â Theory and data analysis, instrumentation;
Atomic Force Microscopy â Principle and modes of operation; Scanning Tunneling
Microscopy â Mode of operations and technical aspects; X-ray Photo Spectroscopy
and Auger Electron Spectroscopy â Theories and Data analysis
